pages.title: Hawking Radiation Collector
pages.text: A collector of Hawking absorber plates and entangled photons that catches the faint radiation evaporating black holes give off. It is warm, and the warmth comes from somewhere it should not. It glitters faintly with stray photons.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Black holes radiate, very faintly, as Hawking predicted. I combined absorber plates with entangled photons to catch the partners of the emitted particles and mounted them on a field emitter.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Singularity Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Eye of the Event Horizon.
